name: Utility-Scale Project Awarded
description: An IPP, developer or EPC contractor wins a utility-scale solar (or solar-plus-storage) tender, auction or EPC contract, creating near-term demand for central/string inverters, BESS and plant monitoring.
matchInstructions: Match when a named company has been awarded, won, or received a letter of award for a grid-connected solar or hybrid project of roughly 20 MW or more, or has been appointed EPC contractor for one, with capacity, site or timeline stated. Also match announced commissioning of a newly won plant still procuring balance-of-system equipment. Do NOT match feasibility studies, expressions of interest, rumoured bids, quarterly results, board changes, or awards/recognition events that do not involve a specific project.

name: Rooftop Solar Mandate or Policy
description: A government body, DISCOM or large property owner announces a rooftop solar mandate, net-metering scheme, subsidy or portfolio-wide rooftop programme that will drive C&I inverter and hybrid-inverter purchases.
matchInstructions: Match when an event announces a binding rooftop solar mandate, a new or revised net metering / rooftop subsidy scheme, or a named commercial landlord committing to rooftop PV across multiple sites with a stated kWp/MWp size or deadline. Do NOT match generic sustainability statements with no rooftop commitment, consultations still at the draft-comment stage with no timeline, or residential-only consumer offers.

name: Industrial Decarbonisation Pledge
description: A manufacturer or industrial group commits to net-zero, RE100 or a Scope 2 reduction target backed by captive solar, storage or renewable sourcing plans — a trigger for C&I solar, BESS and energy-management SaaS.
matchInstructions: Match when a manufacturing or industrial company publicly sets a dated net-zero, carbon neutral, RE100 or Scope 2 emissions target and names concrete levers such as captive solar, rooftop plants, storage or renewable energy sourcing, ideally with a capex figure. Do NOT match ESG ratings, sustainability awards, CSR tree-planting drives, or reports that restate old targets without new investment.

name: Data Centre Build-Out
description: A data-centre operator announces a new campus, expansion or significant IT-load addition, creating demand for battery storage, backup power, on-site solar and energy-management software.
matchInstructions: Match when a colocation, hyperscale or enterprise data-centre operator announces a new facility, land acquisition, construction start or expansion with a stated IT load (MW), investment or go-live date, or a tender for backup power / battery storage at a data centre. Do NOT match customer wins, cloud pricing news, cybersecurity incidents, or leadership changes at data-centre companies.

name: Green Hydrogen Project
description: A developer or industrial offtaker announces a green hydrogen or green ammonia project that will need dedicated renewable power, storage and power-conversion equipment.
matchInstructions: Match when a company announces, reaches financial close on, or receives an allocation for a green hydrogen, green ammonia or electrolyser project with capacity (MW electrolyser or MTPA output), location or dedicated renewable power stated. Do NOT match grey/blue hydrogen, fuel-cell vehicle marketing, academic research grants, or non-binding MoUs with no capacity or site.

name: Power Purchase Agreement Signed
description: A buyer or generator signs a power purchase agreement (utility, corporate, open access or group captive), locking in a project that must now be built and equipped.
matchInstructions: Match when a named company signs a PPA — utility, corporate, group captive or open access — for new solar, wind-solar hybrid or storage-backed capacity, with tariff, term or capacity stated. Do NOT match PPA renegotiation disputes, regulatory tariff petitions without a signed contract, or retail electricity plan changes.
